changes.title: Trunk shadow controls
items: The pause page has every trunk-shadow control: style (soft, hard, off), core, width and a campfire's reach, beside darkness, length and your glow's reach and height

changes.title: Trunk shadows
items: On foot at night, tree trunks and beach palms cast shadows from your own glow and from campfires, swinging round you as you walk

changes.title: Chart steam
items: The hot springs on the map table steam again
